coordinateSource: OSM namedcape/peak nodes raw/control-island-osm.json, CP only; pixels read on original G11 map; twelve town junctions from existing OSM shared-node coordinates, raw/control-roads-osm.json, independently pixel-reread
knownGaps: Modern named-cape/peak tags do not independently establish exact historical point continuity. Fort Canning and Pearls Hill summit identifications require review. Printed revision1937, British War Office1941, AMS reproduction1944.

Second pass drops seven summit/name-place controls: the sheet does not establish that the chosen dot is the surviving geodetic station. Twelve surviving town junctions individually reread in native raster added; nine capes retained as approximate shape/continuity checks, not surveyed monuments. The new town group is spatially concentrated, so whole-island acceptance is not assumed.

Excluded Buloh, Gedong and Irau soft mangrove cape controls because their present named nodes do not establish unchanged historical shoreline positions. Corrected the erroneous G9 Rimau pixel (in open water) and independently reread G11 Rimau/Berlayer rocky tips. Retained six rocky cape controls and twelve built town junctions; western-island surveyed-station controls still missing.
